description: This PHP class 'EmailsCest' contains acceptance tests for the 'Emails' module in a SuiteCRM project, utilizing Codeception testing framework. It defines setup methods, test scenarios for viewing email modules and email content, and interacts with external classes such as AcceptanceTester, ListView, WebDriverHelper, and Faker to perform UI tests.

classes.name: EmailsCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for Emails module, containing setup and scenario test methods.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test, initializes Faker data generator with a random seed.

methods.name: testScenarioViewEmailsModule
methods.description: Test scenario for viewing the emails module list view as an administrator.

methods.name: testScenarioViewEmailBodyHTML
methods.description: Test scenario for viewing email bodies in HTML to check for caching issues; currently skipped.
